chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I used Shinobu - Warding Ring's damage option, dealing 3 to all enemies and defeating both Leaf Slimes, then played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Twig Slime (S), defeating it.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing All Streams Flow to the Sea on Twig Slime (S) first and then using Shinobu - Warding Ring's damage option; it also defeats all three enemies.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up Shinobu - Warding Ring's 4 Block option and left Water's Edge unplayed; it also spent 2 excess damage on Twig Slime (S).
q4_different_intent: No. This line defeats every enemy before any intent resolves, so a different telegraphed intent would not have changed it.
